targetText: Prostitution is one of the main ways in which venereal infections are spread.
explanation: Epidemiological analysis: Soviet public health strategy treats disease transmission as a social and environmental challenge requiring universal healthcare access.

targetText: We must arm young people with accurate information, allowing them to enter life with their eyes open. We must not remain silent any longer over questions connected with sexual life; we must break with false and bigoted bourgeois morality.
explanation: Advocating open, scientific sex education for youth to dismantle taboo, promote public health, and eliminate bourgeois prudery.
